subject: Using imported data from SPSS in Lavaan

messages.author: 46a6f3806d1d9797
messages.subject: Using imported data from SPSS in Lavaan
parts:
I imported my data into R using the following command.

> test.data<-read.spss("/Users/KTee/Desktop/LaavanR/TestData.sav",use.value.labels=TRUE,to.data.frame=TRUE)

I checked the imported data using
summary(test.data)

After specifying my model, I got an error message when I entered the following command:

> fit <- sem(myModel, data=TestData,likelihood="wishart")
Error in lavaan(model = myModel, data = TestData, likelihood = "wishart",  :
  object 'TestData' not found


Please what have I done wrong and any suggestion?

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Using imported data from SPSS in Lavaan
parts:
On 11/22/2012 08:53 AM, KayTee wrote:
> Dear Sunthud,
>
> Thanks for responding to my post.I just did as you suggested and I had
> this other error bellow:
>
> fit <- sem(myModel, data=test.data, likelihood="wishart")
> Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , unlist(ov.names)) :
> undefined columns selected

This means that you have (observed) variable names in your model syntax
that do not appear in your data.frame.

Use names(test.data) to see your variable names. They should match
exactly the _observed_ variables in your model syntax (of course, the
latent variable names should not appear in your data.frame).

Yves.
